key.name: press
key.summary: What a press of the Copilot key does
key.description: "search" opens Start with search, "app" opens the app in the app key, "nothing" ignores the press.

key.name: hold
key.summary: Dictate while the Copilot key is held
key.description: When on, holding the key dictates once dictation is on. When off, the key only does what a press does, as soon as it goes down.

key.name: seen
key.description: Set the first time a Copilot or assistant key is pressed, since keyboards don't say whether they have one. Settings shows the key's options from then on, while a keyboard that can send it is connected.

key.name: app
key.description: The desktop file ID of the app a press opens when press is "app".
